subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: I built a feature at 2AM out of frustration. Here's the real story—and why it's now your favorite tool.
body_paragraphs: It was 2AM. I was on a train, trying to catch up on a podcast, but the HVAC was louder than the host. The volume slider was maxed. I pressed it one more time, hoping for a miracle. Nothing. I snapped. That's the moment I decided to build a feature that would actually fix this—not just pretend.

I started coding right there on my phone. The goal was simple: make audio loud where it matters, clean where it counts. No distortion. No hiss. Just pure, usable volume. I tested it on my own headphones, then on a friend's. Within a week, I had something that worked. That 2AM mistake—thinking the slider could do more—turned into the +200% boost you have in Loudify today.

That boost isn't just louder. It's tuned to save dialogue, not drown it. It's why you can hear a whisper in a movie over a dishwasher. It's the reason I stayed up all night, and it's the part of the app I'm most proud of. You already have it. But have you really pushed it? Go try it on a quiet track—crank it all the way. You'll hear what I mean.

Open Loudify, plug in your headphones, and boost a song or podcast to +200%. Then tell me if you still hear any distortion. I'm betting you won't. P.S. The free version gives you a taste, but Premium unlocks the full boost—no cap, no limit. Just pure, clean power.
